titleStmt.title: Kephalaia of the Teacher, edition page 30: diplomatic and Leiden transcription

sourceDesc.bibl: Kephalaia (Manichäische Handschriften der Staatlichen Museen Berlin), ed. H. J. Polotsky and A. Böhlig, Stuttgart: Kohlhammer, 30. Restorations, sublinear dots, gap counts and corrections are the editors'.

encodingDesc.p: EpiDoc. Read by eye from the page image; gap counts, sublinear dots and supralinear stroke extents verified by measurement on the image. A supralinear stroke is marked on every letter it covers by at least half its width. Spaces are the edition's word division. Facsimile zones are measured line centres. The editors' German statements are not transcribed: each is mapped to an id of the controlled vocabulary data/kephalaia/editorial_vocabulary.json and carried as @ana (ed: statements in the text, app: apparatus footnotes, tr: categories of the transcriber's commentary).

div.p: The framed manuscript page number [ⲗ] is printed with a bar above and below as the frame, not as a supralinear stroke. Measured strokes over ⲣ of ⲛⲣⲣⲟ (701–713) and ⲛ of ⲛⲇⲟⲅⲙⲁ (814–826). The stroke over ϩⲛ (766–785, pixel row) covers ϩ 43 %, ⲛ 60 %: encoded on ⲛ only.

Measured stroke over ⲛⲛ of ⲛⲛⲣⲱⲙⲉ (569–586, pixel row): ⲛ 50 %, ⲛ 53 %, encoded on both. Separate strokes over each ⲙ of ⲙⲗⲙⲙⲁⲩ (817–830, 838–852). The stroke over ϩⲙ (920–942, pixel row) covers ϩ 40 %, ⲙ 67 %: encoded on ⲙ only.
Measured stroke over ⲙⲛ of ⲙⲛⲛⲥⲱⲥ (541–560, pixel row): ⲙ 50 %, ⲛ 57 %, encoded on both.
All ϣ on the page were compared at 6× (ll. 3, 4, 7, 8, 18, 20, 26, 28, 29, 30); none has a separate sublinear dot.
The stroke over ⲥ of ⲕⲁⲧⲥ is printed obliquely. The letter after ⲁⲓ in ⲁⲓϫⲙⲁⲗⲱⲧⲓⲍⲉ is ϫ (6× zoom, compared with ϫ of ϫⲛ in l. 14), as the footnote states.
The edition prints ⲛⲥⲱ(ⲟ)ⲩ with the ⲟ in parentheses inside the restoration; encoded as a restoration without the parentheses.
A colon (:) stands after ⲛⲁⲛⲏϩⲉ at the end of kephalaion 5. The draft markup has a sign only for the end mark :— (no dash is printed here), so the colon is recorded in this note only.

Chapter opening: the numeral ⲋ (6) centred with an overline (932–967); the title follows in ll. 13–16. The marginal numerals ⲋ̄ (overlines left 582–613, right 1226–1260) stand between ll. 14 and 15 (y ≈ 870); they are attached to l. 14.

The restored ⲉ in [ⲉ̣ ⲁ ⲡ] carries a sublinear dot as printed (6× zoom). Measured strokes over ⲙ of ϩⲙ (970–984) and ⲙ of ⲙⲡⲕⲉⲕⲉ (1105–1118).
Measured stroke over ⲛⲛ of ⲛⲛⲥⲱⲛⲧ (905–923, pixel row): ⲛ 53 %, ⲛ 53 %, encoded on both; stroke over ⲧ (988–1001).
